glosses: To make dark or darker by reducing light.

examples.text: […] they [locusts] covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened […]

So spake the Sovran voice, and Clouds began
To darken all the Hill […]

glosses: To become dark or darker (having less light).

examples.text: […] the owl and the bat flew round the darkening trees:
[…] leaning at her window she watched the end of that eventful day darken over the ranges.

glosses: To get dark (referring to the sky, either in the evening or as a result of cloud).

examples.text: Well, I must go in now; and you too: it darkens.

examples.text: She puts on lipstick and darkens her eyebrows, which are now very scanty […]

examples.text: The lovely hair had lost its rose-gold glimmer, and had darkened to rose-brown […]
